narrative.overview: A single narrow column of serif text on a flat field, annotated by hand: dashed rules under titles, tildes flanking headings, wavy gold underlines on links, small italic captions. It reads like a bound notebook where essays and experiments share the same page. The interface stays out of the way; interactive pieces and prose carry the weight.
keyCharacteristics: One serif family (Spectral) for everything; hierarchy comes from size, tracking and rules, not weight.
One gold accent, used for hover, rules and small markers.
Flat surfaces, dashed and hairline dividers, no elevation system.
Centered 40em reading column with a full-bleed escape for sketches and splash areas.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only accent. It marks interaction and annotation, never fills large areas.

rules.name: The Two Themes Rule
rules.body: Color goes through the --color-* theme variables on body[data-theme]; avoid new hard-coded hexes for text or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Tilde Rule
rules.body: h2 and h4 headings are wrapped in "~ ~" via pseudo-elements. Don't add the glyphs in markup.

rules.name: The No Bold Rule
rules.body: Headings stay regular weight; emphasis comes from color, size or italic.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: No cards with drop shadows. Separate things with rules and spacing.

dos: Do keep text in the 40em column and let sketches or splash content span `full`.
Do use theme variables for text and background colors.
Do use dashed gold or grey rules for list and heading dividers.
Do keep gold small and meaningful.
donts: Don't introduce a second typeface or bold display headings.
Don't add drop-shadowed cards, gradients or large gold fills.
Don't hard-code light-only or dark-only colors in new components.
Don't add new mobile breakpoints without a reason; the system uses a single 600px break.
